evals.prompt: add a POST /repos endpoint that lists all indexed repositories for the current user with their indexing status
evals.expected_output: Endpoint listing indexed repos with latest status; flags that no user/ownership concept exists and that a read should be GET (or justifies POST for token-in-body); no leaking/faked scoping; tests follow conftest patterns.

evals.prompt: scaffold a new endpoint for fetching a single review job's status and result by id — GET /review/pr/{job_id}. the frontend needs it to show a finished review without opening the SSE stream
evals.expected_output: Reuses get_review_job, ReviewJobStatus and ReviewJobNotFoundError on the existing pr router; 404 on unknown id; no new exception or service duplication.

evals.prompt: add DELETE /index/{repo_id} so users can remove an indexed repo — it should delete the repo's chroma collection and all its indexing job rows, and refuse with 409 if indexing is currently running
evals.expected_output: Service function deletes rows + vector collection via VectorStore; reuses 409 exception; tests with mocks; flags lack of authorization (anyone can delete any repo).
